name: @bitpay-labs/crypto-rpc
description: A Normalized RPC Interface for Cryptocurrencies

scripts.docker:test: npm run hardhat:compile && npm run hardhat:deploy && npm run hardhat:test && mcr mocha test
scripts.hardhat:deploy: cd blockchain/EVM/ && npx hardhat --network geth run ./scripts/waitForTxIndex.js && export HARDHAT_IGNITION_CONFIRM_DEPLOYMENT=false && export HARDHAT_IGNITION_CONFIRM_RESET=false && npx hardhat --network geth ignition deploy ./ignition/modules/all.js --reset
scripts.hardhat:test: npm run hardhat:clean && cd blockchain/EVM/ && npx hardhat test
scripts.test: docker compose down && docker compose build && docker compose run test_runner
scripts.test:local: npm run docker:test:down && npm run docker:test:build && docker compose run test_runner

author: Micah Riggan
